title: India's diaspora sent home a record $135 billion this year
sources: RBI via PIB, 2026 - India remains the world's largest recipient of remittances, FY25
HDFC Sky, 2026 - India Gets Record $135.46B in FY25 Remittances, Up 14%
World Bank Migration and Development Brief, 2024 - global remittance share data
caption:
Nearly 19 million Indians work outside India. Last year, they sent home more money than any other diaspora on Earth.

India received $135.46 billion in remittances in FY 2024-25, an all-time high, up 14% from the year before - nearly double what Mexico, the second-highest recipient, brought in.

Nearly half of India's overseas workforce is based in Gulf countries, forming the backbone of this flow. The number of Indians working abroad has nearly tripled since 2000, from 6.6 million to 18.5 million. These inflows now make up over 10% of India's total current account receipts.

This isn't foreign aid. It's Indians abroad still building the country they left, one transfer at a time.

Sources: RBI via PIB, HDFC Sky, World Bank Migration and Development Brief
